newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huangshan to list B shares in Shanghai on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan to list B shares in Shanghai on Friday.

text.p: Anhui-based Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd will list 80 million B shares in Shanghai on November 22, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The offer, launched at US$0.258 per share last month, has been fully subscribed, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Anhui Provincial Securities and Shanghai Guotai Securities will be Huangshan's listing promoters, the official said.

Huangshan said in a prospectus it plans to use proceeds from the offer to finance ongoing construction of a third cableway at the Huangshan mountain resort and renovate a hotel there. The 80-million-yuan cableway is nearing completion, it said.
Under international accounting standards, Huangshan is forecasting net earnings of 65 million yuan for 1996, against 41.73 million last year and 27.58 million in 1994.
It said it had net earnings of 10.06 million yuan in the first five months of this year but did not explain the reason for the low earnings in this period.
Huangshan has total share capital of 193 million shares, including 113 million state shares and 80 million B shares.
